latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of partnerships-channel-coach skill.
- Provides structured coaching for B2B SaaS leaders on building channel and partnerships programs.
- Covers key decisions, partnership archetypes, readiness criteria, program design, partner recruitment, enablement, operational mechanics, and common failure modes.
- Distinguishes real channel programs from one-off integrations or affiliate/referral arrangements.
- Designed to trigger on relevant phrases like “partnerships program,” “channel partner,” “reseller,” “co-sell motion,” and more.
